result.narrative:
Intel pays on time: the payment leg records 0 DPD, no worst line and nothing owed on the single exposure. The news file is dominated by one Reuters item of 16 November, a shareholder suit following a 29% stock plunge, scored severity 3. Everything around it is either positive or low-grade market sentiment — the first external customer for the 18A process on 19 November (CNBC, Barron's and others), set against commentary on a 62% decline this year, a stock more than 60% below its June record, and a $3.5T chip rout, each scored severity 1 or 0. Three 8-K filings in the file are routine.

The band is Watch at 20.7. The trace is 0.65 x 0.0 (payment, 0 DPD) + 0.35 x 59.2 (news) = 20.7, so the entire score comes from the news leg and, within it, from the single shareholder-lawsuit article. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and was pointed about them: the driving article's full text is one line identical to its headline, with no claim size, court or allegations; a suit by equity holders is not a trade-payment or liquidity signal; the 0.0 payment input is an absence of reported data rather than a verified clean record, as no payment or payment_review evidence is on file; and the 18A customer win, though newer than the lawsuit, scores severity 0 and cannot offset it under max-severity selection. The adjudicator also noted the score sits only 0.7 points above the threshold, so the band turns on the clock as much as on the credit.

The recommendation is to maintain the export limit for Tamrin Exports at USD 7,000,000, unchanged, with expected loss of 540,288 before and after. PD of 0.1072 is well inside the 0.25 target and maximum liability does not bind. Nothing in the file supports a reduction; the case for maintaining rests on a clean payment record and a positive operational development, both of which the score handles poorly in opposite directions. Worth confirming with the client that trade lines are actually being reported before treating the 0 DPD as reassurance.

The score is 0.7 points above the Healthy line at 20.0, and decay of the lawsuit item alone would carry it there without any change in the buyer's condition. Confirmation that trade lines are being reported and remain clean, or a resolution or dismissal of the shareholder suit, would make that move a genuine one rather than an artefact of ageing news.
